question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank No. 1.
solution:
The correct answer is option 3) i.e. 'on'. 

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The context of the sentence is, that **on which day the 2020 Paralympic Games began.**
 
• According to the above-mentioned points, the most preposition to fill the blank is ‘on'.
 
• Use of 'on'- to denote when a thing is touching the surface of a place; to denote dates and days.
 
 
• Another example: *​Mohit celebrates his birthday** on** 28 July every year.*
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is Option 3.

 

Correct Sentence:__ *The 2020 Tokyo Paralympic Games began __**on**__ Tuesday night...*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] __Additional Information__

 Let's look at the use of other options:

 
 

 Preposition
 Usage
 Example
 
 
 
 

 by
 used to show the person or thing that does something; used to show how something is done; near or at the side of; not later than; at or before
 Please try to reach the theatre by 7 p.m.
 
 

 at
 to denote a particular place or time
 Mangal Pandey started a mutiny against the Britishers at Barrackpur.
 
 

 in
 used to denote when something is inside another thing; to denote unspecified times, months, years, and seasons
 In 1909, Morley-Minto reforms were introduced to change the political condition of India.
